newsitem.title: EGYPT: Medinet Nasr extends free share deadline.
newsitem.headline: Medinet Nasr extends free share deadline.

text.p: Medinet Nasr Housing and Development said on Sunday it was putting back the cut-off date for deciding which shareholders are entitled to free shares.
The board had decided in November to offer a free share for every one issued and said that those holding shares on March 31 would qualify for the bonus share.
But on Sunday, it said in a published advertisement that it would extend this deadline indefinitely until the stock exchange approves the capital increase.
The share issue will increase the paid-in capital to 40 million pounds ($11.8 million) from 20 million. The shares have a nominal value of five pounds each.

Medinet Nasr is one the the state's most successful privatisations. It made net distributable profits of 52.21 million pounds in financial 1995/6, 43 percent up on 36.53 million in 1994/5. The financial year ends on June 30.
